answer: For a 30-day trip, a Seychellois passport holder needs an e-Visa, not the visa-free entry. Seychelles passport holders get visa-free entry for up to 14 days, but your 30-day trip exceeds that, so you'll need to apply for an e-Visa instead. The e-Visa allows stays of up to 90 days, costs USD 25 (single entry) or USD 50 (multiple entry), takes about 2-3 business days to process, and can be used to enter by air, land, or sea at any of 83 approved ports (no need to nominate a single port). Apply at https://evisa.gov.vn/. Your passport must be valid for at least 180 days from your entry date. This data is current as of 2026-08-17 — double-check the latest policy at evisa.gov.vn before you travel.
